annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/609 of 14 April 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/439 as regards harmonised standards on packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices and sterilisation of health care products
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/609 of 14 April 2021 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/439 as regards harmonised standards on packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices and sterilisation of health care products
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 129/150
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision amending Decision 2020/439 to update the list of harmonised standards supporting the In Vitro Diagnostic Medical Devices Directive 98/79/EC, replacing EN ISO 11737-2 and adding EN ISO 11607-1 and -2 on sterilisation and packaging. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces reference of EN ISO 11737-2:2009 with EN ISO 11737-2:2020.
Adds EN ISO 11607-1:2020 and EN ISO 11607-2:2020 to Annex I of Decision 2020/439.
Compliance with listed harmonised standards confers presumption of conformity under Directive 98/79/EC.
Enters into force on the day of publication in the Official Journal.
